title: The Modal System: kell, lehet, muszáj

sections.title: Necessity and possibility in health advice
sections.content: Modals like *kell* (must / have to), *lehet* (can / may / is possible), and *muszáj* (compulsory / must) take a dative subject (*-nak / -nek*) and an infinitive.

items.spanish: Sok vizet kell inni a meleg nyári napokon.
items.english: One must drink plenty of water on hot summer days.

items.spanish: A rendelőben bejelentkezés nélkül is lehet orvossal beszélni.
items.english: In the surgery, one can speak with a doctor even without an appointment.
